source: Gemini API pricing page https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (paid tier, Standard, text input), read 2026-10-29. USD per 1M tokens. `cache_read` is the context-caching read price; hourly cache storage fees are not modelled. `long_context` applies when a request's input exceeds `threshold` tokens. `until`/`after` record an announced step-up: the price in effect on `as_of` is the top-level one. Gemini bills thinking tokens at the output rate. Gemini CLI on a free Google-account (Code Assist) tier bills $0 in real dollars; this table gives the API-equivalent.
